tests.name: IDENTITY_AS_MEANING
tests.expected: same SourceAtom content id, distinct Context kept as separate objects

tests.name: PREDICTION_AS_OBSERVATION
tests.expected: REJECT without an independent ObservationReceipt; TRANSITION schema requires observation_status=OBSERVED + receipt

tests.name: SIMULATION_AS_WET_LAB
tests.expected: REJECT SIMULATED -> IN_VITRO/IN_VIVO/CLINICAL without a receipt at the target level

tests.name: CUSTODY_AS_CORRECTNESS
tests.expected: custody PASS on a deliberately wrong ECA result; correctness check fails; verdict REJECT (ABSTAIN if correctness unchecked)

tests.name: HISTORY_ERASURE
tests.expected: CORRECT/SHUFFLED/NO history recorded as distinct measured conditions; confirmatory measurement is E2 H2d

tests.name: OBSERVATION_LAYER_LOSS
tests.expected: RawFrameSequence shows bombs, sampled AggregatedObservation (built-in frameskip=4) does not, pooled AggregatedObservation does; types kept distinct
